rules.rule_name: Comprehensive Unit and Widget Testing Pyramid
rules.explanation: Releasing mobile applications without automated unit tests or widget tests results in frequent regressions and broken user interfaces after updates.
rules.do: Implement a robust testing pyramid: write thorough unit tests for business logic/ViewModels, widget/component tests for UI elements, and integration tests for core user flows.
rules.dont: Do not rely entirely on manual QA testing for complex mobile codebases and business logic.

rules.rule_name: Automated Mobile CI/CD Pipelines and Build Signing
rules.explanation: Compiling release binaries and managing provisioning profiles or keystores manually on local developer machines increases human error and security risks.
rules.do: Automate mobile build and deployment pipelines (e.g., using GitHub Actions, Bitrise) with secure, centralized management of signing certificates and keystores.
rules.dont: Do not store release signing keys in public repositories or generate production builds manually on local laptops.

rules.rule_name: Automated Beta Distribution and Crash Reporting
rules.explanation: Releasing apps to production without staging beta tests or monitoring live crash reports leads to massive user churn during critical failures.
rules.do: Integrate automated beta distribution pipelines (e.g., TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution) and real-time crash reporting SDKs (e.g., Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry).
rules.dont: Do not push updates directly to production app stores without prior internal or closed beta testing phases.

rules.rule_name: UI Golden and Screenshot Testing for Visual Regressions
rules.explanation: Unintended visual changes, overlapping text, or broken layouts can slip into production without automated visual regression checks.
rules.do: Implement automated screenshot or golden tests to verify UI rendering consistency across different screen sizes and themes.
rules.dont: Do not skip visual validation checks when updating UI component libraries or design systems.
